_note: Canonical animation-name → sprite map for ClaudeTeam-M03-Dev (v3 92x92 persona). PixelLab does NOT export the semantic animation_name; its metadata.json keys by an action-description slug + folder. This file is the authoritative map the webview trigger logic + manifest generator (scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs) consume. VALUE FORMAT: a bare folder name `<state_folder>` means that folder holds exactly ONE animation (resolve animations/<sole-slug>/south/frame_*.png); a `<state_folder>/<anim_slug>` value names a SPECIFIC animation inside a folder holding MORE THAN ONE. active_work + active_read SHARE the sitting_at_a_desk_wo desk state (state ff8ca3ab — same desk posture → no flip during active sessions), so both use the folder/slug form. idle_pool = [idle_coffee, idle_stretch, idle_think] (webview picks at random). NO active_pool (single active_work pose); active_work is the single-pose fallback for running + tool != Read. Slugs discovered from the harvested metadata.json — not guessed.
_playback_note: Per-animation playback tuning (anim-playback epic E2, 86ca2187g). Keyed by canonical anim name (must exist in `animations`). Fields (all optional): speedMultiplier (fraction of default frame RATE; 0.5 = half speed), dwellFrameIndex, dwellMs, finalDwellMs, playbackMode, startFrame/endFrame. Malformed values dropped + warned by scripts/build-sprite-manifest.mjs. Mirrors F02's slow-calm defaults; sponsor retunes on reload with zero gens (edit + npm run build + reload).
